remarks: Set among the trees on Four Wheel Drive, this distinctive 6-bedroom, 6-bath Ellicottville mountain home offers approximately 4,071 square feet of living space across multiple levels, combining generous accommodations with the warmth and character of a true ski-country retreat. From the moment you step inside, the architecture makes an impression. The dramatic great room is the centerpiece of the home, featuring soaring ceilings, oversized arched windows, beautiful wood flooring and an impressive floor-to-ceiling stone wood-burning fireplace. Exposed beams and natural wood details enhance the mountain atmosphere, while the expansive windows fill the space with natural light and bring the wooded surroundings indoors. The kitchen offers abundant wood cabinetry, generous counter space, an island and breakfast seating, with an easy connection to the dining and gathering areas. Multiple living spaces throughout the home allow everyone to gather together or find a comfortable place of their own. With 6 bedrooms and an extra sleeping room, this home sleeps 14 people comfortably. A dedicated ski-entry area provides plenty of room for skis, boots, coats and equipment, an especially valuable feature in a four-season mountain home. This ski in/ski out chalet makes coming and going for a day on the slopes easy while helping keep outdoor gear organized. Outside, multiple decks extend the living space and provide several places to enjoy outdoor dining, summer evenings or the changing colors of fall. The distinctive geodesic hot tub dome situated on the deck creates a unique additional outdoor gathering space and adding even more personality to this one-of-a-kind property. Located at HoliMont and convenient to the Village of Ellicottville, Holiday Valley, dining, golf, hiking, mountain biking, festivals and year-round recreation. 11 Four Wheel Drive puts the Ellicottville lifestyle within easy reach. Whether you're looking for a ski-season home, weekend escape or a place to enjoy Ellicottville throughout the year. Fully furnished. This chalet had 2 additions over the years, so square footage was calculated using CubiCasa. Floor plans attached in MLS.
